title: LK-99 room-temperature superconductor papers
summary: Jack tells of LK-99 room-temperature superconductor papers, about 2023 at South Korea / China, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Do you know that that team was so sure of their results that they published one paper with six authors and then they published another paper with three authors because only three people can share a Nobel Prize. They were that confident.

plain: In 2023, a research team linked to South Korea put out papers about a material called LK-99, which they said was a superconductor at room temperature. That means a material that carries electricity with no loss at all without being chilled to extreme cold, which would change technology if true. A podcast host named Jack says the team was so sure of their results that they published one paper with six authors and then a second with only three, because a Nobel Prize can only be shared by three people.
